children: US technology-based education firm's fiscal Q1 revenue rose 3% yr/yr, beating analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS for fiscal Q1 fell 10% yr/yr
Net income for fiscal Q1 declined 6% yr/yr
Stride forecasts full-year 2027 revenue between $2.53 bln and $2.61 bln
Company expects full-year 2027 adjusted operating income of $500 mln to $530 mln
Stride projects full-year 2027 effective tax rate of 24% to 26%
CAREER LEARNING GROWTH - Higher Career Learning Middle-High School revenue and increased enrollments drove segment growth
REVENUE PER ENROLLMENT - Company said higher revenue per enrollment contributed to overall revenue growth
SEGMENT DECLINES - Lower General Education and Adult Career Learning revenue offset some gains
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 3 "strong buy" or "buy", 2 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the miscellaneous educational service providers peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Stride Inc is $124.60, about 53.8% above its October 19 closing price of $80.99
The stock recently traded at 11 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 11 three months ago
